description_sq:
Century 21 Terra sjell per ju Vile dhe toke per shitje ne zonen Priske e Madhe ne Tirane. Vila ndodhet 13 km nga qendra e Tiranes. Vila organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje bashke me ambientin e gatimit dhe te ngrenies, depo, lavanteri dhe tualet.
Ne katin e dyte organizohet ne 3 dhoma gjumi, dhome garderobe dhe tualet. Vila ka nje oborr teper relaksues qe te ofron nje pamje te lire . Zona karakterizohet per qetesi dhe ajer te paster.
Ofron siperfaqe totale toke prej 2110 m2, nga ku siperfaqe trualli 800 m2 dhe ndertim 163.24 m2 te ndare ne dy kate si me poshte:
Siperfaqja e tokes mund te shfrytezohet dhe per ndertimin e vilave te tjera.
Infrastuktura eshte e rregullt dhe me akses te lehte ne rrugen kryesore . Vila eshte edhe nje mundesi e mire investimi per agroturizem.
Per me shume detaje, kontaktoni agjentin imobiliar!
title_en: VILLA FOR SALE IN PRISKE - DAJT
description_en: Century 21 Terra brings you Villas and land for sale in Priske e Madhe area in Tirana. The villa is located 13 km from the center of Tirana. The villa is organized in a living room together with a cooking and dining area, a storage room, a laundry room and a toilet. On the second floor, it is organized into 3 bedrooms, a wardrobe room and a toilet. The villa has a very relaxing yard that offers a free view. The area is characterized by calmness and clean air. It offers a total land area of ​​2110 m2, of which the land area is 800 m2 and the building is 163.24 m2 divided into two floors as follows: The land area can also be used for the construction of other villas. The infrastructure is regular and with easy access to the main road. The villa is also a good investment opportunity for agritourism. For more details, contact the real estate agent!
